selection_rule: Exactly 13 unique personal, individual-creative, or small-studio sites with official CSS Design Awards recognition and an accessible About, Bio, Info, Intro, or Studio page/section.

sites.name: Camila Rosa
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm and direct. Confidence comes from specificity and the work's social point of view, then from quiet evidence rather than adjectives.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large declarative headline over a restrained two-column editorial grid; dense credentials are reduced to labeled counts that open on demand.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A short vertical scroll. The face/eye illustration gives the opening personality; achievement rows disclose detail on interaction without burdening the first read.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Click/tap rows reveal lists. Navigation remains conventional and touch-safe.
sites.media_or_simulation: Expressive portrait illustration and eye motif; no gratuitous simulation.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It separates identity from proof: two sentences explain the practice, while clients and achievements supply credibility in compressed form.
sites.transferable_lesson: Use one memorable personal visual, two sharply edited statements, then evidence as expandable counts. This is a strong model for a one-minute Alexander page.
sites.avoid: A long undifferentiated client list can become wallpaper; cluster or animate only enough to preserve recognition.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: The icon-like expandable rows need explicit button semantics, focus states, and expanded-state announcements. Motion should not be required to understand the content.
sites.capture_notes: All page sections were scrolled through before capture so lazy content was loaded. Full page captured at 1440px CSS width.

sites.name: Elsa Hanneke
sites.creator_type: individual artist and interdisciplinary creative director
sites.tone_and_confidence: Cool, concise, and assured. It never claims greatness; the client list and recognition ledger do the status work.
sites.typography_and_layout: Monospaced/editorial system with small section labels and spacious columns. The entire About page fits in one desktop viewport.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: No scrolling is necessary on desktop; the work index carries the spatial innovation while About becomes a calm information panel.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Black/white background switch and standard links. Low interaction burden.
sites.media_or_simulation: About is text-only, contrasting with the spatial project index and moving media elsewhere in the portfolio.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: The page knows its job: orientation and proof. It avoids repeating portfolio content and creates a deliberate pause in an otherwise immersive site.
sites.transferable_lesson: A visually ambitious portfolio does not require every About moment to perform. Let expressive typography and spatial transitions frame concise facts.
sites.avoid: The client block is impressive but emotionally cool; Alexander needs at least one human detail or belief to avoid reading like a credits list.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: The background controls must retain contrast and accessible names. Tiny monospaced type needs careful mobile sizing.
sites.capture_notes: Complete one-viewport About page captured at 1440x1000; no hidden lower sections.

sites.name: Wendy Andrade
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Poetic and third-person. Confidence comes from a clear cultural purpose and a single Wired recognition, not a catalogue of achievements.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large portrait and generous whitespace; one substantial paragraph is treated as an art statement rather than résumé copy.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Simple vertical movement with the portrait preceding the statement. The image-to-text ratio creates a slow, reflective reveal.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Minimal; language switch and contact links only.
sites.media_or_simulation: One portrait. The broader site uses a fluid stream of titles and media inspired by water.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It gives the practice a worldview in roughly one paragraph. The page feels authored even with very little interface.
sites.transferable_lesson: A compact About can be memorable when it names what the work is for, not only what the person does.
sites.avoid: Dense third-person prose can feel like gallery copy and may distance the reader. Break Alexander's copy into more breathable beats.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Ensure language controls expose state and that the portrait has useful alt text. Long line lengths should be constrained.
sites.capture_notes: English Bio URL redirected correctly; complete 2031px page captured after lazy-load scroll.

sites.name: Ania Melnik
sites.creator_type: individual multidisciplinary designer and AI artist
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Energetic, maximal, commercial, and highly self-assured. The breadth is impressive but the repeated superlatives push toward sales copy.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized kinetic sentences, repeated vertical modules, marquee fragments, and an intentionally dense multi-section scroll.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical page with word-by-word text entrances, embedded motion, repeated capability modules, and section color/rhythm changes.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Anchor navigation, social links, and repeated collaboration calls. Much of the experience is scroll-triggered rather than pointer-led.
sites.media_or_simulation: Embedded moving media, oversized type, and animated section choreography rather than a single signature simulation.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It proves that type alone can carry sustained kinetic rhythm, but it is intentionally not efficient as a one-minute profile.
sites.transferable_lesson: Borrow the alternating typographic scale and clear chapter changes, not the volume. One strong sentence per beat is enough.
sites.avoid: Role stacking, repeated calls to action, duplicated claims, long service inventories, and percentage-style expertise all make the profile feel less selective.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Letter-split DOM creates an extremely noisy accessibility tree; motion density, embedded media, and long scroll increase cognitive and performance cost. Reduced-motion behavior is essential.
sites.capture_notes: Full 8762px one-page profile captured after all sections were scrolled into view. This is intentionally retained as an anti-pattern/control case.

sites.name: Alex Ryan Design
sites.creator_type: independent identity, web, and digital designer
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Confident and commercially clear, with a conversational close. Evidence is concrete, though the category-redefining promise is more assertive than the supporting story.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large split typography opens the page; compact editorial lists and modular cards create a measured downward rhythm.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Vertical scroll with word-level entrances and distinct sections. Dark-mode control adds a light secondary interaction.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Theme toggle, links, and copy-email affordance. Interaction supports rather than competes with reading.
sites.media_or_simulation: The About page is primarily kinetic typography; project media remains outside the narrative.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: The two engagement models answer a practical hiring question most About pages ignore, turning biography into useful decision support.
sites.transferable_lesson: Include a compact 'how I work with teams' beat; it makes professional positioning more actionable than a generic skills list.
sites.avoid: Awards descriptions and the long client wall duplicate proof. Trim to the strongest handful for a one-minute page.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Word-split animation should preserve a clean accessible name. The dark-mode toggle needs persistent state and sufficient contrast.
sites.capture_notes: Full 3041px About page captured after triggering all scroll entrances. This site replaced Tomoya Okada to avoid cross-lane duplication.

sites.name: Luca Ravanelli
sites.creator_type: small art-direction and motion-design studio led by an individual
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Formal, exacting, and philosophy-led. Confidence is expressed through principles such as reduction, grids, precision, and synthesis.
sites.typography_and_layout: Minimal black-and-white Swiss/editorial grid; a large About title gives way to compact, information-dense columns.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Short conventional vertical scroll with subtle type entrances. Information density increases below the opening statement.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Straightforward links and downloadable CV; no interaction gimmick.
sites.media_or_simulation: No media on About. The site's playground holds motion studies, maintaining a useful separation between biography and experimentation.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: A single coherent principle explains both style and studio evolution. The page then acts as a reference sheet for serious enquiries.
sites.transferable_lesson: Lead with a belief that actually governs decisions, then use a compact ledger for proof. Alexander can do this more warmly and with fewer lists.
sites.avoid: The philosophy paragraph is abstract and the lower half becomes administrative. Add a concrete example or playful interruption before attention drops.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Very small secondary type and long lists may be tiring on mobile; ensure headings and list semantics remain intact through animation.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 1991px About page captured; all lists and footer content visible.

sites.name: Maria Vareva
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Calm, intelligent, and self-aware. Numbering contains the confidence; the prose stays factual and avoids inflated claims.
sites.typography_and_layout: One very large paragraph becomes the entire page. Numbered clauses, line breaks, and linked nouns create rhythm without extra interface chrome.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A focused 2903px vertical reading experience. The text enters progressively and linked trajectory items act as visual anchors.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Links deepen specific career claims; otherwise scrolling remains primary.
sites.media_or_simulation: Minimal animated marks associated with linked projects; the core story is typographic.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It integrates role, past, beliefs, and values into 151 words. The sequence answers who, where from, how, and why in under a minute.
sites.transferable_lesson: This is the strongest content architecture for Alexander: current edge, selective trajectory, actual principles, and human values, each in one numbered beat.
sites.avoid: A single giant paragraph may be hard to scan and feels formal. Alexander should add one or two playful media interruptions and stronger mobile chunking.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Word-level animation and large text must preserve natural reading order. Embedded linked objects should not interrupt keyboard flow.
sites.capture_notes: Full About page captured after scroll reveals; all 151 words and footer visible.

sites.name: Aya El Ouahdani
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Playful, energetic, and game-like. Confidence is expressed through a complete fictional system rather than conventional biography.
sites.typography_and_layout: Terminal language, outlined panels, neon accents, counters, and modular cards create a coherent interface fiction.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Long vertical scroll; trait meters animate, projects react on hover, and a secondary Aurora mode alters the atmosphere.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Hover-to-preview modules, mode switch, project controls, and contact buttons. On touch, hover semantics require an alternate first-tap behavior.
sites.media_or_simulation: Animated avatar, progress meters, interactive project previews, and game/terminal motifs.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: Every interaction reinforces the maker's developer identity. The fiction is consistent rather than decorative.
sites.transferable_lesson: Choose one behavioral metaphor tied to Alexander's actual practice—such as spatial scan/dot field—and let it govern reveals, labels, and transitions.
sites.avoid: Tool percentages, broad capability lists, and system jargon overwhelm the human story. Do not let the metaphor consume the one-minute narrative.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Hover instructions are not touch-complete; small terminal text, heavy animation, and generic progress values create usability and performance risks. A reduced-motion and non-WebGL path is necessary.
sites.capture_notes: Full 9400px one-page portfolio captured after all modules and lazy media were scrolled through.

sites.name: Stan Khoruzhenko
sites.creator_type: individual design leader and product designer
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Direct and highly outcome-oriented. The confidence is credible when tied to numbers, but the uninterrupted first-person pitch is intense.
sites.typography_and_layout: Single dense narrative column with inline company links; minimal visual hierarchy beyond the Introduction label.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Short 1805px scroll and no material reveals. The page reads like a high-impact cover letter.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Inline links to employers and case studies; otherwise static.
sites.media_or_simulation: None on the Bio page, despite a more animated work homepage.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It explains contribution, scope, and measurable outcome instead of listing generic responsibilities.
sites.transferable_lesson: Alexander's trajectory should name what changed because of his work, not only where he worked. One or two verified outcomes can carry considerable authority.
sites.avoid: The wall of text exceeds a comfortable one-minute scan and repeats 'I'. Break the arc into chapters and reserve numbers for the most meaningful evidence.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Readable semantics and low runtime cost, but line length and paragraph density reduce comprehension, especially on smaller screens.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 1805px Bio captured after all content loaded.

sites.name: AKIS.STUDIO
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm and earnest but agency-generic in places. Confidence comes from a visible team and a partnership promise more than from awards.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large kinetic headings alternate with images, short paragraphs, team cards, and logo fields across a long editorial scroll.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Scroll is the main narrative engine; oversized headings reveal word by word, team cards move horizontally, and image scale resets pacing.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Carousel controls and standard links; no essential hover-only information.
sites.media_or_simulation: Team photography and an animated hero scene; the media is tied to place and people.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: The alternating rhythm is strong even when the writing is long. Team portraits turn abstract collaboration claims into visible evidence.
sites.transferable_lesson: Use recurring large-type chapters separated by one concrete image, artifact, or simulation. Alexander can create the same rhythm with side projects and dot-field moments.
sites.avoid: Repeated passion/authenticity/excellence language and a 494-word page feel generic. Specific decisions and outcomes are more persuasive.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Very tall page and animated split text increase runtime cost; carousel must remain keyboard/touch accessible and reduced-motion should flatten heading reveals.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 11967px Studio page captured after all scroll reveals and team/client media loaded.

sites.name: Jess Hill
sites.creator_type: individual author, journalist, educator, and advocate
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
narrative_sequence: book and newsletter calls to action
sites.tone_and_confidence: Authoritative, candid, and deeply personal. It earns confidence through reporting detail and vulnerability rather than self-promotion.
sites.typography_and_layout: Editorial longform with sticky chapter navigation, large images, timelines, award cards, and intimate captions.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A 15370px chaptered vertical story. Sticky anchors make the long page navigable; image/caption interludes continually reset the reading rhythm.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Anchor navigation, expandable award media, and article/book links. Scrolling remains dominant.
sites.media_or_simulation: Portraits, archival photographs, awards, videos, personal snapshots, and captions; no abstract simulation.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It is not reading-efficient, but it demonstrates how professional trajectory becomes a story through turning points, mentors, stakes, and human detail.
sites.transferable_lesson: Borrow the chapter anchors and the alternation between professional turning points and small human artifacts. Compress the same technique into five Alexander beats.
sites.avoid: Eleven-plus minutes is far outside the brief. Exhaustive awards and biography should live in expandable/archive layers, not the primary one-minute path.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Strong semantic headings and anchor navigation, but page weight, many images/videos, and extremely long reading time create cognitive and performance costs. Media lightboxes need focus management.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 15370px page captured after every chapter was scrolled. Retained as the strongest narrative reference and clearest length anti-pattern.

sites.name: Bogdan Kolomiyets
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Confident, conversational, and funny. It repeatedly frames expertise as client benefit and uses self-deprecation to prevent the pitch from feeling pompous.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized statements, annotated personal image collage, numerical proof blocks, and numbered manifesto cards.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: Strong vertical pacing across 7565px: image collage, metric reveals, a large personal-service sentence, then four belief modules.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Mostly scrolling and links. Images and text animate into place; no interaction is required for core content.
sites.media_or_simulation: Personal photographs of wife, dog, seaside life, and humorous snapshots. These are meaning-bearing rather than decorative.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: It solves the confidence/likeability balance unusually well. Beliefs are stated as client-relevant truths, then levity closes the loop.
sites.transferable_lesson: Use one unexpected personal artifact, one plain-English service promise, and a short belief set. End with a joke that still advances the contact decision.
sites.avoid: The conversion language can feel overly sales-driven, and 320 words still exceeds the one-minute target. Keep only the best two beliefs.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Split text creates a large DOM and animated statistics must expose stable text. Personal images need meaningful alt descriptions; reveal motion should respect reduced-motion.
sites.capture_notes: Complete 7565px About page captured after all counters, photos, and manifesto modules loaded.

sites.name: Giacomo Agnello Modica
sites.award: Special Kudos plus UI, UX, and Innovation public awards
sites.tone_and_confidence: Cheerful, specific, and disarming. Major clients and recognition are balanced by drag theatre, an old bicycle, comfort food, divas, and rainy places.
sites.typography_and_layout: Illustrated fragments, short paragraphs, client names, and playful button-like phrases create an informal scrapbook rhythm.
sites.scroll_and_reveals: A concise 3316px scroll. Hover/tap ingredient buttons reveal corresponding visual references, making the taste statement interactive.
sites.pointer_touch_behavior: Influence and favorite-thing buttons are optional playful layers; core biography stays visible without interaction.
sites.media_or_simulation: Illustrated self-portrait fragments, influence images, personal references, and self-produced merchandise.
sites.why_efficient_or_innovative: Every playful detail explains the work's visual language. Personality, side work, and professional proof are not separate decorations—they form one causal story.
sites.transferable_lesson: This is the strongest model for Alexander's side-project sprinkling: let artifacts reveal influences and taste, and make each interaction answer 'why is this here?'.
sites.avoid: The client list could be shorter, and copy errors weaken polish. Ensure interaction labels work on both hover and tap.
sites.accessibility_performance_caveats: Some figures lacked accessible image names in the captured accessibility tree. Button-revealed images need alt text, keyboard triggers, and persistent touch behavior.
sites.capture_notes: Cookie notice declined before capture. Complete 3316px Info page captured after all lazy content loaded.

excluded_reference_capture.name: Tomoya Okada Portfolio v7
excluded_reference_capture.reason: Excluded from the 13-site count because the Awwwards lane independently selected the same site.
